the synthesis of Cx-SiY-HA with controlled composition, the characterization of the powders and the manufacture of bioceramics for bone tissue engineering.
the development of new bioceramic materials with controlled amount of carbon and silicon in the apatitic structure for bone tissue engineering applications.
